title: Supervisor recognises a network that blocks the tunnel port and stops churning the quick tunnel
acceptance_criteria: Observed 2026-10-08: after sleep on a network that blocks outbound TCP 7844, the supervisor restarted cloudflared every 10 minutes (6 launches), changing the public link each time while no tunnel could connect

When the cloudflared log shows repeated 'dial tcp ...:7844: i/o timeout' with no registered connection, the supervisor marks the tunnel 'network blocks tunnel port (7844)' on status.json and link.html and stops restarting it; it retries with a long back-off (e.g. 30 minutes) and resumes normal checks as soon as a connection registers
No other component behaviour changes; parse check 0 errors; unit test of the detector on recorded log lines
Measured live on the blocking network: no restarts while blocked; status shows the reason
